title: cacalia elaeagnoides
intro: Cacalia elaeagnoides, commonly known as Japanese buttonbush, is a plant species belonging to the Asteraceae family. It is valued for its potential health benefits, which include anti-inflammatory, antioxidant, and antimicrobial properties, making it useful for treating various ailments such as wounds, skin conditions, and respiratory issues. The therapeutic actions of Cacalia elaeagnoides include promoting wound healing, reducing inflammation, and exhibiting immunomodulatory effects. The bioactive constituents present in this plant include sesquiterpenes, flavonoids, and phenolic acids, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
